findings: All 800 paired actions and all 11,789,067 compared feature float values match exactly; full and incremental candidate ordering and closing flags match.
V3 also matches all 800 earlier ample-budget actions. Recorded board prefixes remain exact against accepted paint/cells/scores.
Play allocations decline from 30,374,096 to 3,553,776 bytes (88.30%); on large maps from 16,612,360 to 1,086,272 (93.46%).
Pooled local play wall time declines by 1.85% overall, 0.77% on large maps, and 3.08% on smaller maps.
This pass confirms the allocation objective and equivalence; its small noisy wall-time difference does not establish a material speedup or CG timing improvement.
